name: manual_b7d7be
claim: For a security PR that must be reconciled from a limited sandbox, preserve every remote tip with an immutable backup ref; work in a clean linked worktree from the verified head; simulate and resolve conflicts additively; verify the exact resulting tree and parent chain; publish only a normal fast-forward update (never force); then re-fetch the remote head and compare the intended tree before reporting. For cross-repository endpoint-policy stacks, declare the exact peer ref rather than assuming equal branch names or silently falling back to main.

decisions.notes: Recovery of PT #395/#396 showed that a force update or content-only replacement can close a PR and obscure its review lineage. The repair used ordinary two-parent merge commits, immutable backup refs, exact-tree verification, and an explicit PT-to-Orama policy-stack ref so CI validates the real peer branch.

rationale: Recovery of PT #395/#396 showed that a force update or content-only replacement can close a PR and obscure its review lineage.
